That's why this doodle book for kids has pages with cute drawings of little animals and children's scenes to fill with color, along with entertainment and pastimes such as mazes, connect the dots, counting, finding objects and more.

Little challenges for curious kids who have no time to get bored!

Title: Doodles and Games to Learn
Description:
Author: Libsa
Binding: Paperback
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Bond
Width: 21
Height: 30
Summary

Daydreaming while coloring is a very healthy activity for kids: by letting their minds wander, they can notice what matters, improve their focus and become more creative.

Every doodle in this book has a double purpose: it can be colored in, but it's also the starting point for little games and brain teasers: counting objects, finding the repeated or the odd one out, connecting the dots, solving puzzles and more.

Little challenges for curious kids who have no time to get bored!

Title: Delicious Creative Coloring
Description:
Author: Libsa
Binding: Paperback
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Bond
Width: 24
Height: 33.5
Summary
The quirky illustrations in this coloring book offer an almost dreamlike picture of our relationship with food. It features all the foods of our dreams, from the latest fast food trends and the most tempting drinks to a selection of sweets so exquisite that on every page we'll feel like we're in a little gourmet paradise where thousands of cakes, cookies and ice creams float around. The best part is that our drawings aren't fattening, and they're surely the most fun way to satisfy cravings and release everyday stress.

Title: Don Quixote of La Mancha
Description:
Author: María Mañeru
Age: +8
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 27
Height: 28

Summary

Don Quixote of La Mancha is one of the most important books in literature, and perhaps the most famous novel. Written by Miguel de Cervantes more than four centuries ago, it is still read all over the world today.

Good old Alonso Quijano goes mad reading books of chivalry and can think of nothing better than to set out, under the name of Don Quixote of La Mancha, with his horse Rocinante and his squire Sancho Panza, to do good.

Title: The Little Prince
Description:
Author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
Age: +6
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 27
Height: 20
Summary

The little prince lives on a very small asteroid, and one fine day he decides to travel to visit other planets. Along the way he meets unusual characters, such as the king, the lamplighter, the businessman and the geographer, until he reaches Earth. There he comes across a pilot whose plane has crashed in the middle of the desert.

It's a story full of longing for lost childhood, for the clean, innocent way children see the world, and for the simplicity of things against the greed, hunger for power and boundless possessiveness of adults. Because, as the little prince learns on this journey, you have to look with the heart, since what is essential is invisible to the eye.

ANTOINE DE SAINT-EXUPÉRY was born in Lyon (France) in 1900 and disappeared during a flight mission on July 31, 1944, after taking off from Corsica. He combined his work as a pilot in the French Air Force with writing.

The Little Prince is his best-known work, for which he wrote both the text and the illustrations.

Title: Great World Records
Description:
Author: José Luis Tamayo - Inés Martín
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 23.5
Height: 30
Summary

Great World Records presents nature's most astonishing records and humanity's most spectacular achievements: from the tiniest animal to the most gigantic airplane. The book is divided into two parts: the first focuses on nature and the universe, showing the amazing scale of some planets, oceans and animals and making astonishing comparisons between their sizes.

The second part shows extraordinary key events in human history, as well as the incredible technological discoveries that have let us break records and helped us evolve.

The text is completed with a glossary of the most common terms, a thorough index and more than 300 spectacular illustrations.

Title: Jeans or Miniskirt?
Description:
Author: Noemí Marcos Alba
Binding: PAPERBACK
Cover: CARDBOARD
Inner Paper: BOND
Width: 17
Height: 21.5
Summary
Do you really think you know your friends well? Even your best friend? Now you all have the chance to find out how close you really are. Pass this book's quiz questions to all your friends; each of them must answer honestly, and so will you. Then compare what you have in common and what makes you different, but careful! Some of their answers might take your breath away! TO FIND OUT... Your artistic side • Study time • About clothes and beauty • Dinner is served • You're invited to a party • Stories to keep you up at night • Create an imaginary world • Hooray for science! • Technology and me • How do you get around? • Are you a problem-solver? • Vacations • Family • Jobs • When I grow up... • What an animal! • Best friends • Boys • At home.

Title: Burger or Pizza?
Description:
Author: Noemí Marcos Alba
Binding: PAPERBACK
Cover: CARDBOARD
Inner Paper: BOND
Width: 17
Height: 21.5
Summary
Do you really think you know your friends well? Their tastes, preferences, personalities? Do you even think you know yourself? Now you have the chance to find out how close you really are. Pass this book's quiz questions to all your friends; each of them must answer honestly, and so will you. Then compare what you have in common and what makes you different, but careful! Some of their answers might take your breath away! TO FIND OUT... My free time • I like it! • Shopping mall • Let's eat! • You're an animal! • Myself • Clothes • In class • Your personality • At the movies • Showtime • Sports... Let's play! • What an invention! • On a trip • My room • The professional • Girls! • Your stuff • Your future • Your day off • The best.

Title: Fantastic Optical Illusions
Description:
Author: Gianni A. Sarcone and Marie-Jo Waeber
Binding: Paperback
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 23
Height: 29
Summary

Can you trust what you see? Of course not! And that's the most fun part. Fantastic Optical Illusions has more than 150 new visual tricks of every kind that will try to fool you, so your brain will have to work hard.

This book has the best and most interesting examples of optical illusions: ambiguous and impossible figures, hidden objects and incredible effects, false perceptions of length, size and shape, designs that seem to move and visual paradoxes.

Title: Do Not Disturb the Dead
Description:
Author: Alejandra Ramírez Zarzuela - Agustín Celis
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary

An abandoned house, a mysterious fog, a lonely cemetery... these are must-have ingredients in any scary story. The collection presents a careful selection of chilling tales to enjoy fear, and to enjoy being afraid, without forgetting the fun. Some of the best short horror stories by Edgar Allan Poe, Bram Stoker, Charles Dickens, Oscar Wilde... are gathered in this collection, adapted into approachable language and beautifully illustrated.

Stories to tell before bedtime or to read around a campfire. Dare to read them! An old abandoned mansion in the middle of the countryside hiding a deadly trap; a woman back from the dead who returns home, though her family doesn't exactly welcome her; dead people who leave their graves at night to explain the real reason they died...

Want to have fun being scared? "Do Not Disturb the Dead" will give you an unforgettable time reading terrifying stories that are sure to leave their mark... Are you ready to try?

Title: Unexplained Events
Description:
Author: Alejandra Ramírez Zarzuela - Agustín Celis
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary
An abandoned house, a mysterious fog, a lonely cemetery... these are must-have ingredients in any scary story. The "Terrifying" collection presents a careful selection of chilling tales to enjoy fear, and to enjoy being afraid, without forgetting the fun: some of the best short horror stories by Edgar Allan Poe, Bram Stoker, Charles Dickens, Oscar Wilde... are gathered in this collection, adapted into approachable language and beautifully illustrated. Stories to tell before bedtime or to read around a campfire. Dare to read them! Sweet little Amelia, for whom time had stopped for some completely unknown reason; the man who tricked the devil with a clever ruse but lost his shadow in return; the strange case of Mr. Valdemar, in a hypnotic trance from just before the moment of his death... Want to have fun being scared? "Unexplained Events" will give you an unforgettable time reading terrifying stories that are sure to leave their mark. Are you ready to try?

Title: Nightmares from Beyond
Description:
Author: Alejandra Ramírez Zarzuela - Agustín Celis
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary

An abandoned house, a mysterious fog, a lonely cemetery... these are must-have ingredients in any scary story. It presents a careful selection of chilling tales to enjoy fear, and to enjoy being afraid, without forgetting the fun: some of the best short horror stories by Edgar Allan Poe, Bram Stoker, Charles Dickens, Oscar Wilde... are gathered in this collection, adapted into approachable language and beautifully illustrated. Stories to tell before bedtime or to read around a campfire.

Dare to read them! Madame Crowl committed a crime so dreadful that she even came back
from the Beyond to pay for it; Friar Pedro went so far with his experiments that he put his soul in danger; a terrible secret drove Fettes mad, the man in charge of receiving the bodies at the University's Anatomy Department... Want to have fun being scared? "Nightmares from Beyond" will give you an unforgettable time reading terrifying stories that are sure to leave their mark... Are you ready to try?

Title: Manga Rituals and Divinations
Description:
Author: María del Pozo
Binding: Paperback
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 14
Height: 18.5
Summary
The Rituals and Divinations collection presents boxed sets with a handbook and a deck of 42 cards to learn to read destiny in different kinds of tarot and put positive magic rituals into practice. Manga looks to the style of Japanese illustration for deep Eastern spirituality, guiding you through a unique oracle full of magical symbols that will help us look inside ourselves and carry that lesson toward a better future.

Title: Fantastic Beings Rituals and Divinations
Description:
Author: Anselmo Martín
Binding: Paperback
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 14
Height: 18.5
Summary
The Rituals and Divinations collection presents boxed sets with a handbook and a deck of 42 cards to learn to read destiny in different kinds of tarot and put positive magic rituals into practice. Fantastic Beings brings together a whole cultural universe as old as humanity, in which fabulous creatures such as orcs, griffins, mermaids, elves and centaurs, among others, help us consult our destiny, answer our riddles or seek a brighter future.

Title: Cave Fairies
Description:
Author: Alejandra Ramírez Zarzuela
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 27
Summary
For thousands of years, a few lucky humans, usually children, have been able to see a fairy up close. Thanks to them we know that fairies look sweet and charming, and that they're tiny, mischievous beings who protect nature. Don't tell anyone, but I'm one of those people: one day I went deep into the most hidden caves and caverns, climbed the steep cliffs and looked out from the highest, loneliest mountains to see the daring, adventurous fairies who live hidden among the rocks or in palaces underground. All those legends now reach you, so you can discover the wonderful world of fairies.

Title: Fairies: My First Stencils
Description:
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Cardboard
Width: 22.5
Height: 22.5
Summary

If you love the world of fairies, this is definitely your book: by following the instructions on each page you can make a complete fairy costume with materials that are easy to find at home, and use the stencils to draw them and color them however you like.

Use the stencils to design your own birthday invitations or greeting cards, original gift tags, or a pretty mobile to decorate your room!

Title: The Pirate's Handbook
Description:
Author: Alejandra Ramírez Zarzuela
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 29
Summary

If you want to become a real pirate and sail the seas, "The Pirate's Handbook" teaches you all the keys and tricks to be one of the most feared buccaneers. You'll learn how they lived, what their ships were like, their clothes and tools, and their day-to-day life at sea. You'll also dive into the history of the most important pirates
and their great exploits.

At the end of each chapter, you're the star: you'll learn games to play with your friends as if you were a crew. You can also make your own flag, draw a treasure map and create lots more accessories. Dare to discover the pirate world and all its secrets

Title: Timeless Princesses
Description:
Author: María Mañeru
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary

The princesses from the classic fairy tales have been transformed! Read their adventures and discover that not everything is the way you've always been told (it's much more fun): little Princess Rosa is such a sleepyhead that no suitor can wake her up; Cindereparty meets the "different" prince of her dreams.

Snow White is so spoiled and arrogant that not even the dwarfs can stand her, and Rapunzel is now the trendiest hairdresser in the kingdom, among many other stories. Be surprised by this collection of funny stories with unexpected endings.

Title: Witches, Sorceresses, Fairies and Enchantresses
Description:
Author: María Mañeru
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23

Summary

The witches and other characters from the classic fairy tales have been transformed!

Read their adventures and discover that not everything is the way you've always been told (it's much more fun): Snow White's stepmother isn't so bad, fairies are just as mischievous as elves or more, the witch from the gingerbread house now lives in a sweet
and luxurious skyscraper, and Maleficent Devil runs an organization of supervillains, among many other stories.

Be surprised by this collection of funny stories with unexpected endings.

Title: Very Royal Princesses
Description:
Author: María Mañeru
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary

Royal princesses aren't what they used to be!

Read their adventures and discover that they aren't all tall, nice, vain, pretty... perfect! Believe it or not, there are lying princesses who learn wise lessons in the end; some who are total disasters but still find their Prince Charming; and even some so messy that they need their fairy godmother's tricks to tidy their room, among many others. Be surprised by this collection of funny stories with unexpected endings.

Title: Vampires, Ghosts and Other Creatures
Description:
Author: María Mañeru
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary

Vampires and other beings from beyond aren't what they used to be!

Read their adventures and discover that not everything is the way you've been told (it's much more fun): despite her name, Vampira Dracull is a timid girl looking for friends;
that the bag woman, not the bag man, collects magical objects but doesn't take away naughty children; the bogeyman isn't a terrible creature but a mischievous elf; and Nessie, the creature that lives in Loch Ness, is a friendly sea monster who doesn't like being alone, among many other stories. Be surprised by this collection of funny stories with unexpected endings.

Title: Mysterious Shipwrecks
Description:
Author: Anita Ganeri
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 23.5
Height: 30
Summary

Presents gripping true stories, along with the surprising facts hidden under the flap on each page.

Read the true stories of some of the world's most famous "Mysterious Shipwrecks", from a lost pirate treasure to the grave of an unsinkable ocean liner.

Then lift the flap to be surprised by the facts behind each event. It includes:

3D illustrations specially designed to explain each story, bringing the underwater world of shipwrecks back to life.

Full-color photos accompany the hidden facts.

Gripping texts written for the book by a well-known children's author, carefully crafted not only to entertain but also to inform.

Title: Famous Mysteries
Description:
Author: Anita Ganeri
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 23.5
Height: 30
Summary

This book presents gripping true stories, along with the surprising facts hidden under the flap on each page. Read the true stories of some of the world's best-known "Famous Mysteries", from the strange disappearances in the Bermuda Triangle to sightings of a giant ape-man in ancient redwood forests.

Then lift the flap to be surprised by the facts behind each event. You'll find:

3D illustrations specially designed to explain each story, bringing some of our world's most famous mysteries back to life.

Full-color photos accompany the hidden facts.

Gripping texts written for the book by a well-known children's author, carefully crafted not only to entertain but also to inform.

Title: Adorable Pets
Description:
Author: Libsa
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 27
Summary

The Animal Kingdom collection brings the most spectacular animals to early readers through stunning large-format pictures and simple texts that are easy to understand and spark their curiosity.

Adorable Pets presents a selection of the most popular dog breeds, with charming pictures of the funniest, sweetest puppies. Little ones will learn about their favorite pet's size and weight, as well as its temperament, diet and behavior at home, to give the best welcome to a new member of the family!

Title: Witches
Description:
Author: Luis Tomás Melgar
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 17.5
Height: 24.5
Summary

The medieval witch, shrouded in darkness and mystery, was often nothing more than a woman who knew the healing power of plants, or a midwife, who under the Inquisition's suspicion ended up unjustly accused and executed at the stake.

This book tells the real story of these women, the persecution they suffered, and the trials, torture and death sentences of the most famous cases. Beyond the historical view, it also explores folk tales and the collective imagination to give a complete picture of the witch: what she looked like, what her daily life was like, what her acts of magic or heresy were, such as covens, and which spells and arts of divination she used.

Title: Snakes and Reptiles
Description:
Author: Susan B.
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 23.5
Height: 30.5
Summary

Features more than 85 of the world's strangest, scariest and most striking snakes and reptiles. Includes annotated, full-color illustrations of each animal, with
maps, detailed scene drawings and explanations.

The easy-to-read texts give lots of information about each creature, with vivid descriptions of their behavior and hunting techniques.

Each entry comes with a fact table of the key data and figures for quick reference and comparison.

Title: How to Draw Fairies
Description:
Author: Sandra Llanas - Carolina Aquinos
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 27
Summary

Deep in the forest, in that land of fantasy where fairies, elves and gnomes live, there's a magical world we all believed in once and
long to return to in our imagination. Although only children can see fairies, anyone can draw them so realistically that they seem to fly off the page beating their ethereal wings, because "How to Draw Fairies" is a practical handbook for learning both the life and customs of these wonderful beings and the best tricks and painting techniques to bring them to life.

Thanks to the step-by-step structure, the simple and concise explanations and the many examples of hand-drawn and digital drawings, we can all become privileged witnesses to the lives of fairies, filling our own with beauty, magic and mystery.

Title: Comics: A History in Pictures
Description:
Author: Paloma Corredor
Age: +8
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 27.5
Summary

Who didn't spend long, slow summer afternoons reading comics? Who didn't turn on a flashlight under the covers to finish an album behind their parents' backs? We all dreamed at some point of having superpowers to save humanity from the crazy plans of the great villains.

Time, which pushed our comics into the attic, is now what brings back the same excitement from the past. This genre, sometimes seen as a cultural byproduct for children and young teens, joins literature and art and rubs shoulders with film, fashion and even politics, becoming an item of great sociological interest, impossible to classify, and able to stir enough passion to support specialty stores and lead fans to spend considerable sums of money on their collections.

They're the ones who deserve a book that traces the origins of comics, how they evolved and the greatest names the genre has given us.

Title: A Whole Bunch of (Terrifying) Ogres
Description:
Author: Eva M. Lalanne
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary
Dusk falls in the forest, you creep closer to its lair and the smell turns damp and rotten, you hear its growls and its breath, you see it and hold back a scream... you never thought ogres really eat children!

Title: (Dangerous) Space Invaders
Description:
Author: Lola Maeso Fernández
Publisher:
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Cardboard
Width: 23
Height: 23

Summary
It's nighttime, the sky is calm and starry, and there's nothing to fear... right? From the depths of the universe some eyes are watching you, poor earthling, and they know you'll soon live through an alien invasion.

Title: History's Most (Famous) Villains
Description:
Author: Eva M. Lalanne
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary
Are you sure the villains in fairy tales don't exist? Look behind you: maybe a demon, a witch, a wicked stepmother or a werewolf is stalking you right now... and they won't always lose.

Title: Mummies and Other (Very Lively) Dead
Description:
Author: Eva M. Lalanne
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 15
Height: 23
Summary
Mummies and Other (Very Lively) Dead. Life after death is still a mystery. If it's true that someone can come back, does that mean they'll turn evil? Maybe not, but who would dare to find out? Just thinking about it is chilling...

Title: Sex: Understanding Girls
Description:
Author: Carla Nieto
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 29
Summary

Adolescence is a time full of changes and new emotions. The Teen Sex collection helps you clear up the big questions that may come up at this stage, in a friendly, easy way. Boy or girl, you can pick the book that best fits your concerns and helps you discover the little secrets of sex.
Your body has started to change, your habits aren't the same, you look different... What's happening to you? Adolescence has come knocking.

Sex: Understanding Girls aims to explain to girls, and to any boy interested in the subject, what young people go through at this stage of life: understanding menstruation, the role friends play and the different ways of communicating, how sexual desire awakens and the urge to win over a boy, plus all the information about sexual relationships. Who isn't curious about what happens to the opposite sex? Find out!

Title: Sex: Understanding Boys
Description:
Author: Carla Nieto
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Coated

Height: 29
Summary

Adolescence is a time full of changes and new emotions. The Teen Sex collection helps you clear up the big questions that may come up at this stage, in a friendly, easy way. Boy or girl, you can pick the book that best fits your concerns and helps you discover the little secrets of sex.
Your body has started to change, your habits aren't the same, you look different... What's happening to you? Adolescence has come knocking.

Sex: Understanding Boys aims to explain to boys, and to any girl interested in the subject, what young people go through at this stage of life: understanding wet dreams, the role friends play and the different ways of communicating, how sexual desire awakens and the urge to win over a girl, plus all the information about sexual relationships. Who isn't curious about what happens to the opposite sex? Find out!

Title: Extraordinary Characters Collection (3 Titles)
Description:
Author: Carla Nieto
Age: +7
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated

Summary

Through the books in this collection, girls and boys will discover anecdotes, hidden truths, coincidences, mysteries and legends about the great figures of history, which will help them better understand their lives and achievements.

Titles
  • Women in History
  • Explorers of History
  • Protagonists of History

Title: Protagonists of History
Description:
Author: Carla Nieto
Age: 7
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 27

See the full collection
Summary

Extraordinary Characters collection: Women in History, Explorers of History, Protagonists of History. With this book you won't just travel through time: you'll get to know up close the incredible lives of history's most important figures. Some were great kings, explorers or conquerors; others never left home, but let their imagination and creativity fly and became great artists, inventors or scientists. They were all different, extraordinary people, with personalities strong enough to change history, so open the first page and get ready... This story begins in Egypt, about 3,000 years ago.

The diaries of Queen Hatshepsut or Pharaoh Ramesses II will leave you wide-eyed, and that's only the beginning, because then you can go conquer the world with Alexander the Great, Julius Caesar or Attila, the terrible king of the Huns. If you like adventure but not military life, you can travel with Jules Verne; we guarantee thrills all the way to the bottom of the sea... or to the Moon! If you prefer a quieter life, become a scholar and learn math with Hypatia, painting with Leonardo da Vinci or physics with Einstein. Maybe you have a curious spirit? You could always invent the lightning rod with Franklin or explore the deepest mysteries and secrets with Nostradamus... Now, you're the protagonist.

Title: Explorers of History
Description:
Author: Carla Nieto
Age: +7
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 27

See the full collection
Summary

Extraordinary Characters collection: Protagonists of History, Women in History, Explorers of History. All the explorers in this book had a big dose of adventurous spirit, determination, courage, perseverance, a bit of good luck, lots of curiosity and also a pinch of madness. Thanks to that, they made very important discoveries that proved very useful to humanity.

Almost all of them traveled thousands of kilometers without the means we have today, reaching places where no one had ever been, facing a thousand and one setbacks, and fighting until they reached the goal they set out for on their journeys and explorations.

As Theodore Roosevelt said, courage is not having the strength to go on; it is going on when you don't have the strength.

Title: Women in History
Description:
Author: Carla Nieto
Age: +7
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 20
Height: 27

See the full collection
Summary

Throughout history, women haven't always had it easy when it came to living the life they had chosen, studying, working in their calling or speaking their minds. The reason? Simply being female.

The lives of the women in this book overturn all those ideas
found in society that have largely been the reason women haven't always enjoyed the same rights as men, and why their work, effort and achievements haven't been recognized in the same way either.

They all have one thing in common: their attitude toward life. They didn't resign themselves or sit back; they fought for what they believed they deserved and grew strong in the face of adversity.

Title: Restless Minds
Description:
Author: Lola Maeso Fernández
Age: +6
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 22
Height: 28

Title: Brain Teasers
Description:
Author: Lola Maeso Fernández
Age: +6
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 22
Height: 28

Title: Bones and Tracks Collection (2 Titles)
Description:
Author: Carmen Martul Hernández
Age: +7
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated

Summary

How can you recognize the animals in these books by their skeletons and fossil remains? The explorers will give you clues about when they lived, their size, weight, diet and habits. And if you're still not sure... turn the page! There you'll find the secret prehistoric animal and solve every intriguing clue, discovering lots of curious facts.

Titles
  • Bones and Tracks: Animals
  • Bones and Tracks: Dinosaurs

Title: Our World
Description:
Author: María Sevillano
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Cardboard
Inner Paper: Coated
Width: 23.5
Height: 30
Summary

Many different peoples live in our world. What are those very different continents and countries like, and how many cultures are there on planet Earth? Our World takes you to faraway places, from the Amazon jungles and the cities of North America to the African deserts and the Siberian tundra. Get to know the countries, discover all kinds of cultures and customs, and see what daily life is like for all those peoples.

Discover our world and much more with the Encyclopedia of Knowledge. This multi-volume series with beautiful illustrations is the first reference library for curious, inquiring minds.

Title: Incredible Dinosaurs
Description:
Author: María Mañeru
Age: +5
Binding: Hardcover
Cover: Padded
Inner Paper: Cardboard
Width: 22
Height: 29
Summary

Millions of years ago, some terrible creatures that seem monstrous to us today lived on planet Earth: the dinosaurs.

Today we only have a few bones to work out what these animals were like and how they lived. We often picture them as gigantic and fierce, even though their kind also included peaceful vegetarian giants.

With this book of incredible facts and illustrations, you'll discover all the curiosities and amazing facts you always wanted to know about dinosaurs, just by lifting the surprise-filled flaps on each page.

Become an expert paleontologist of the Triassic, Jurassic and Cretaceous, following in the footsteps of the dinosaurs!
